title: Hertzian contact mechanics for sphere indenter
action: Compute the Hertzian contact radius, mean pressure, and strain/strain-gradient fields for a rigid spherical indenter (R=60 nm) on an elastic half-space (Nb:SrTiO3, Young's modulus 270 GPa, Poisson's ratio 0.24) under a force of 4 μN. These fields are needed for the flexoelectric polarization calculation in the next step.
description: This step implements Hertz contact theory to obtain the contact radius a and the strain and strain-gradient fields in the semiconductor half-space. The contact radius is required to compute contact area and the strain gradients drive the flexoelectric bound charges.
output_schema: optional evidence file with contact radius and key strain-gradient summaries

title: Compute all charges and write computed_charges.json
action: Compute the depletion charge from the 1D field-dependent permittivity model (α=0.04 V/nm, γ=14.8 V/nm) using donor concentration N=2.24e26 m⁻³, Schottky barrier Φb=1.4 V and Fermi level ζF=0.065 V. Calculate the depletion charge density per unit area and total depletion charge over the contact area A=πa². From the strain gradient fields obtained in step 1 and the flexoelectric tensor coefficients (μ1111=-380 nC/m, μ1122=-103 nC/m, μ1212=-1.4 nC/m), compute the flexoelectric polarization, then the interface bound charge ΔQ_if and surface bound charge ΔQ_sf by integrating the appropriate surface charge densities. Compute the induced metal charge ΔQ_m on the grounded sphere via image-charge approximation. Finally, assemble the net charge transfer for two limiting cases: (b) surface-conduction regime ΔQ_tot_b = ΔQ_d − ΔQ_if − ΔQ_sf; and (c–e) no-surface-conduction regime ΔQ_tot_c = ΔQ_d − ΔQ_if. Write all quantities to `computed_charges.json` with the keys: depletion_charge_density_e_per_nm2, contact_radius_nm, depletion_charge_total_e, flexoelectric_interface_charge_e, flexoelectric_surface_charge_e, induced_metal_charge_e, total_charge_transfer_case_b_e, total_charge_transfer_case_cde_e.
description: This step integrates the depletion and flexoelectric models to produce the final computed charges—the paper's main quantitative results. The output is a single JSON file with all required quantities.
output_schema: JSON object with keys: depletion_charge_density_e_per_nm2 (float), contact_radius_nm (float), depletion_charge_total_e (float), flexoelectric_interface_charge_e (float), flexoelectric_surface_charge_e (float), induced_metal_charge_e (float), total_charge_transfer_case_b_e (float), total_charge_transfer_case_cde_e (float).
